<translate>
'''Yajirobe's Katana''' is the only signature weapon you can craft. It uses the '''katana''' moveset: a fast 4-hit combo with a reach of 2.75 blocks, built for chaining quick, aggressive slashes. It also has the highest critical-hit chance of the signature weapons.
</translate>

<translate>
== Crafting ==

Crafting table: <code>_ _ I / G I _ / S G _</code>, where I is an Iron Ingot, G is a Gold Ingot, S is a Stick and _ is an empty slot.
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighting with it ==

* '''Moveset:''' katana, a fast 4-hit combo that loops as you keep swinging.
* '''Critical hits:''' 25% chance, 10% critical damage.
* It can break: it has 500 durability.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Special Weapons|Special Weapons]] for how movesets, combos, blocking and parrying work.
